info.description: [![rescupybs](https://img.shields.io/pypi/v/rescupybs?style=flat-square)](https://pypi.org/project/rescupybs/) [![rescupybs](https://img.shields.io/pypi/pyversions/rescupybs?style=flat-square)](https://pypi.org/project/rescupybs/) [![rescupybs](https://img.shields.io/pypi/l/rescupybs?style=flat-square)](https://pypi.org/project/rescupybs/) [![rescupybs](https://img.shields.io/pypi/dm/rescupybs?style=flat-square)](https://pypi.org/project/rescupybs/) [![rescupybs](https://img.shields.io/pypi/wheel/rescupybs?style=flat-square)](https://pypi.org/project/rescupybs/) [![rescupybs](https://img.shields.io/github/last-commit/lkccrr/rescupybs?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/lkccrr/rescupybs) [![rescupybs](https://img.shields.io/github/release-date/lkccrr/rescupybs?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/lkccrr/rescupybs) ### rescupybs The rescupybs is used for band structure plotting or isosurface file exporting from ***rescuplus*** calculation result \*.json and \*.h5 files. The code will provide two scripts, rescubs for band structure plotting using ***rescuplus*** \*.json or \*.dat files, and rescuiso for isosurface file exporting in ***VESTA*** format from \*.json and \*.h5 files. *** rescubs * To execute rescubs \-h for the parameters to use. * Example: ```bash rescubs -h rescubs -i nano_bs_out_bs.dat -o band.png -l g m k g rescubs -b -l g m k g -y -1.2 1.2 ``` *** rescuiso * To execute rescuiso \-h for the parameters to use. * Example: ```bash rescuiso -h rescuiso -i nano_wvf_out.json -k 2 -b 2 ```
info.name: rescupybs
info.summary: Band structure plot from rescuplus json file.
